original.target_description: Single experiment (study 1): interaction of instruction type (free versus serial recall) and sound condition (quiet, phonologically dissimilar, phonologically similar) on overall proportion of correct recall; 2 × 3 mixed ANOVA. Serial recall scored by position; free recall scored regardless of position.

n.sample_role: Participants in the mixed ANOVA across both recall-instruction groups; residual between-participant df = 46 corroborates the 48-person analytic sample.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported in the supplied published article.

notes: Original published article title and DOI match the assigned reference. Selected the instruction type × sound condition interaction because the neutral description compares the disruption across free and serial recall. The locator identifies only a page; the same page also reports a free-recall simple comparison (t(23) = 3.94, p < .001, d = 1.64) and a serial-recall simple comparison (t(23) < 1.00, p = .53, d = 0.30). These are distinct tests and were not combined with the selected interaction. The ANOVA includes the quiet condition as well as the similar/dissimilar conditions. Reported success is unassigned for this original-only validation.
